name: Revelation
section: New Testament: General Letters and Revelation
author: John, traditionally the apostle John.
date: Often dated about AD 95, though some propose the 60s.
setting: Written to seven churches in Asia Minor facing pressure.
theme: Christ wins, evil is judged, and God makes all things new.

outline.label: The new heaven and new earth

christInBook: Revelation is the unveiling of Jesus Christ (1:1). He is the first and the last, the lamb who was slain and is worthy, the faithful and true rider, and the bridegroom who returns for his bride.
howToRead: Revelation is full of symbols, and most of them come from the Old Testament. Read for the big picture: Christ reigns, the church is called to faithful witness, evil is judged, and God makes all things new.
